svg.aria-label: Nijam — A free AI scam checker for India in 12 Indian languages: an Android shield that checks messages on the phone, plus a web checker, API and MCP server. Clareo — Private, on-device fatigue, eye-strain and posture coaching for people who work at a screen all day.
